<thought>The mass spectrum shows a series of peaks spaced by ~1.003 Da with relative intensities that match the natural 13C isotopic distribution (M+1 ≈ 9 % of M, M+2 ≈ 0.6 % of M, etc.). No significant M+2 peak characteristic of Cl, Br, or S is present, and the pattern is consistent solely with carbon. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
